_help: Keys are channel names (as shown on YouTube) or channel IDs, case-insensitive. Options: include_regex, exclude_regex (match the video title; add "search_description": true to also search the description), min_minutes, max_minutes, priority ("must", "high" or "low"), format ("audio" or "video", overrides the CSV), always_include (true = always shown, skips the AI), note (free-text instruction for the AI). Delete the examples below and add your own.
